items.title: This Month in AWS DevOps Agent: November 2026
items.summary: Introduction November brought AWS DevOps Agent to AWS GovCloud (US-West) and added AWS Organizations support, so teams can connect an entire organizational unit to an Agent Space instead of one account at a time. Investigations now complete faster and show a real-time summary as they run. Replay and automatic Reviews give teams a way to […]
